package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

type node struct {
	next  *node
	Value int
}

func main() {
	b := &node{Value: 2}
	a := &node{Value: 1, next: b}
	// a → b → nil: no cycle, the pointee crosses whole and no back-reference
	// is spelled.
	fmt.Println(a.Value, b.Value, a.next == b, b.next == nil)
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("%p", a) == fmt.Sprintf("%p", a), fmt.Sprintf("%p", a) == fmt.Sprintf("%p", b))
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintf("%T", a), strings.HasPrefix(fmt.Sprint(a), "&{"), strings.Count(fmt.Sprint(b), "0x"))
}
